Small Update:

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Bugfix Update:

- Fixed a bug causing inventory slot overwritten when moving from storage to inventory with RMB
- Fixed rotating items in inventory would sometimes overwrite the next or under inventory slot
- Fixed moving to equip slot not working sometimes
- Now it is not required to rotate the item to fit the equip slot, the item will automatically adjust itself
- Fixed Storage and car trunks not saving items rotation

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update is focused on fixing all the problems with inventories and storage containers such as car trunks or storage chests. 

Sadly, after this update you will need to start a new game, because the way save now works is different.

- Fixed items duplication
- Fixed chest disappearing on load
- Fixed inventory items alignment
- Fixed Furnace items not saving on exiting
- Fixed furnace light
- Fixed campfire light
- Added salt to drops
- Added vegetables to drops

Next update will be focused on FPS optimization.
